info.title: Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-urwb-oper
info.description:
This module contains a collection of YANG definitions
     for URWB(Ultra Reliable Wireless Backhaul) operational data.
     Copyright (c) 2025 by Cisco Systems, Inc.
     All rights reserved.

Cisco IOS-XE operational state data (read-only).
**Category:** Wireless
**Paths:** 5

get.description: URWB operational data and configuration status. (collection)
URWB operational data and configuration status. (collection)
URWB operational data and configuration status.
URWB operational data and configuration status.

wtp-mac.description:
Unique MAC address of the Wireless Termination Point (AP).
         Used as the key to identify each AP in the URWB network

urwb-prf-inuse.description: Name of the URWB profile currently applied to the AP

enabled.description:
Boolean flag indicating whether URWB functionality is enabled
         on this AP

cfg-crd-mode.description: Coordinator mode as configured for the AP

crd-mode.description:
Current operational coordinator mode of the AP.
         May differ from the configured mode due to runtime conditions

client-id.description: Identifier for the client instance in the URWB network

urwb-support.description: Boolean indicating whether the AP support URWB features and protocols

mesh-id.description: Identifier for the URWB mesh network to which the AP belongs

urwb-phr-hash.description: Hash of the URWB passphrase sent to the AP

mcast.description: Multicast mode configuration for the AP

coord-name.description: Name of the coordinator AP associated with this AP

urwb-cfg-status.description:
Current configuration status of URWB on the AP.
         Indicates success, failure, or pending configuration apply

nw-tree-lvl.description: Indicates the depth of AP in the coordinator's network hierarchy

rf-tag.description: RF tag applied to the AP

coord-mac.description: Base radio MAC address of the coordinator AP

items.description: List of EtherType values configured for the AP
List of configuration error strings encountered by the AP
List of URWB configuration error types
List of radio roles assigned to the AP's radios

mobility.description: Mobility configuration and runtime status for the AP

mpls.description: MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching) configuration and status

mpo.description:
MultiPath Operation (MPO) configuration and status.
         Details about multipath routing and redundancy for the AP
